title: Execution and polish

reconstruction.evidence: Project-owner review rejected the earlier interface as insufficiently usable and too shallow relative to the frozen design research.
reconstruction.impact: The earlier uncorroborated 5/5 judge-first claim was withdrawn and Gate 7 was reopened.
smallestReplacement: connected dependency graph with upstream/downstream inspection
baseline deltas, deterministic trend charts, change markers, timestamps, and evidence IDs
mitigation assumptions and exact approval scope
provenance-labelled contextual Focus Mode with Escape dismissal
consistent resolved telemetry, authority, and active configuration
regressionGates: fresh-viewer judge-first acceptance on revised public deployment

followupUsabilityCorrection.evidence: A direct project-owner walkthrough reached an empty Agent timeline filter that said only 'No agent events in this incident' and did not explain how to start the WebMCP workflow.
followupUsabilityCorrection.impact: A first-time viewer could mistake the expected pre-agent state for a broken integration and would not know what request to give the agent.
smallestReplacement: show the exact canonical first agent request in the initial incident panel
explain that agent calls visibly update the same workspace
state the visible-human-approval boundary in the handoff cue
replace dead-end Agent and Human filter messages with next-action guidance
followupUsabilityCorrection.browserReview: PASS — real supported browser exposed the exact nine-tool document.modelContext surface and rendered the cue and filtered guidance

browserAutomation.webMcpHarness: test-only document.modelContext harness exercising production registry and executors

claimBoundary: The original UX reconstruction is deployed as Sites version 4. The agent-handoff correction at e2734ae is locally tested but not yet deployed. Gate 7 remains reopened until that correction is publicly deployed and independent fresh-viewer acceptance is repeated against it.
